# ReelCut

> ReelCut is a video editor that runs entirely in the browser: trim, arrange, adjust, add captions and render a finished file. Footage is never uploaded, because the site has no backend.

## Pages

- [Home and editor (English)](https://reelcut.dawidolko.pl/): the editor, how rendering works and FAQ
- [Home and editor (Polish)](https://reelcut.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the same page in Polish

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
